about: Which web outcome stands for which ages in a person's death hazard (infants, ages 55 to 64). The causes of death, with their sourced shares by age, are in death-causes.json.

personLevel.about: Where a full person's own coverage is modeled (the law reach keeps the Medicaid coverage of the town's residents by person id), their hazard at these ages reads their own coverage record through the person-level link, and the place-level twin row is left out of their web factor so the expansion moves them once (src/core2/health-own.ts).
